decisions.reason: As a second-year product that extends the core dumper range and has already absorbed launch and engineering investment, management is likely to keep it and interpret any remaining weakness as normal market development rather than a reason to reverse course.

This articulated dumper remains close to the established construction offer, and after a visible launch the firm is likely to persist with it because prior commitment and strategic fit make withdrawal harder to justify absent clear failure evidence.
Given the reported large order and rental-market popularity for this closely related product line, management has both positive feedback and strong commitment reasons to continue rather than retreat.

Although more distant from the traditional range, the dedicated market presentation and strong early operating result give management enough evidence and sunk commitment to continue backing this underground mining loader.
